name: @pipeworx/mcp-pride

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search EBI PRIDE Archive — the largest public proteomics/mass-spectrometry dataset repository — for projects by keyword (disease, organism, technique, protein, instrument). Returns matching project accessions with title, organisms, diseases, and instruments. Keyless.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get full metadata for one PRIDE Archive proteomics project by accession (e.g. "PXD000001"): title, description, sample-processing and data-processing protocols, organisms, organism parts, diseases, instruments, keywords, and DOI.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-pride forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the pride pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
